Name: Morpho Butterfly Fairy
Author: namidaame
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Exactly what it says on the tin: lets you have a morpho butterfly following you around instead of the vanilla fairy options. Perfect if you're a fan of butterflies, blue, or the Morpho minion from FFXIV.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]No AI was used in the making of this mod. Pixel art lovingly made by me in MS Paint.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod should be compatible with other CP mods that change trinket appearances, including the fairy box. Disable any settings that affect the fairy companion appearance.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45964]Em's Trinkets and Companions[/url].[/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: Morpho Butterfly Fairy
Manifest.Description: Retextures fairy companion into a morpho butterfly
Manifest.Author: namidaame
